notes: Planar enclosure skins and chamfered outline; no compound curved outer lid.
Only rigid envelopes and local channel voids checked; no exact connector map, flexible wire sweep or75mm FPC routing proof.
Local mounting posts reachY40, beyond the30.4mm housing; do not report30.4 as the entire front assembly depth.
Carrier and dock nuts are installed before closing the barrier; actual fastener lengths and PETG bearing strength pending.
One lightweight common rigid skeleton carries MB, raised camera and IMU, independently of the front lid.
Camera and IMU reference solids intentionally contact retainer/support planar faces with zero volume.
The assumed IMU PCB end isX18..38, DuPont endX38..53. Verify on the physical board; do not tighten against chips or sockets.
Printed1.7mm M2 pilot holes are provisional; use fit coupon and appropriate fastener trial. No slicer/support, head fit, electrical or contact validation.
Battery-onlycase and two independentpods; no rigid link betweenpods,cradle,battery.
Adjustable6mm retainingribbon and compliantpad candidates in eachcase. Contact maps remainphysicalpending; no hard pouchface clamp.

Ø3.6 round-bottom wire ports now open to removable cover seams by3.6 lay-in slots; existing terminals need not be removed for threading. NominalØ2.9 bundle unchanged. Actualwirelength,diameter,bend,grommet,seal andstrainrelief pending.
Smoothinnerpodpanel is a trialtransmissionsurface, not a tactile/skin/strength/headfit claim. Mainwalls1.6.
Contact-side curves/pads unchanged; added thickness extends toward enclosure. Nose opening kept; no hard bridge across nose.
Two separate flat brackets replace all four inclined rod arms; broad front-loaded nut pads on frame. Assemble brackets to frame first, then fasten complete module to shell from rear.

New4M2x10 screws and4M2 nuts are candidates for frame/bracket joints; actual washers, thread engagement and tip clearance require trial. Existing four shell screws may be reused only after length check.
3mm skins/wide webs/roof root are geometric changes, not validated head-fit, strength or material results.
Speaker retained as one left unit, separate from haptic pods. Acoustic seal, strain relief and safe clamping force unverified.
